descriptions.w3d_path_search_destroy: Tears down the AI path search: resets it, frees the path, clears the global instance and frees all bucket storage.
descriptions.w3d_path_node_distance: Returns an octile-style grid distance between two path nodes (14 per diagonal step, 10 per straight step).
descriptions.w3d_path_bucket_find: Searches one hash bucket for a node with the same grid cell, optionally returning its index in the bucket.
descriptions.w3d_path_table_find: Hashes a node's x coordinate to a bucket and looks up the node there, optionally reporting bucket and index.
descriptions.w3d_path_bucket_clear_8000532c: Deletes every node stored in a hash bucket, removing them from the back.
descriptions.w3d_path_table_clear_80005398: Clears all 1024 buckets of a node hash table and resets its node count.
descriptions.w3d_path_table_erase: Removes the node at a given bucket and index from a hash table and decrements its count.
descriptions.w3d_path_search_status: Returns the path search's status word.
descriptions.w3d_path_search_remaining: Returns how many path steps remain to be consumed.
descriptions.w3d_path_search_next_step: Returns the next node of the computed path and advances the path cursor.
descriptions.w3d_path_cost_construct: Initializes a small path cost object with a very large negative limit and enables it.
descriptions.w3d_path_cost_destroy: Destroys a path cost object and optionally frees its memory.
descriptions.w3d_path_search_pop: Takes the next node to expand: from the candidate list if non-empty, else the best entry of the open table.
descriptions.w3d_path_search_remove_candidate: Removes a node from the ordered candidate list if present and updates the lowest recorded candidate cost.
